title: Speculative enquiry: graduate site engineer (Atherton Tablelands, Far North QLD)
content_text: No advertised engineering vacancy (web search 13 Oct 2026 found only a plant operator advert from 2026 and a 2020 experienced civil engineer post). Careers page 'Working at RCG' reads: 'Please call 07 4096 2399 or email recruitment@robinsoncivil.com.au' and quotes Anthony Wong, Engineer: 'Since I started in 2019 as a site engineer, RCG has provided me ongoing professional development opportunities and support'. It also says RCG offers 'quality training with the support from qualified and years' experienced supervision' and has received State and Australian Training awards. About: 'Far North Queensland's leading civil construction company', 'a medium-size enterprise', family owned. Projects page: 'We Know Roads.' Road rehabilitation on Millaa Millaa to Malanda Road (641), Atherton Tablelands, in situ stabilisation, removal and replace and asphalting at Tarzali (June 2023, Department of Transport and Main Roads); Kennedy Highway Mareeba to Kuranda and Mareeba to Ravenshoe road safety improvement packages and Palmerston Highway Innisfail to Ravenshoe road safety improvements for TMR. Capabilities: road construction, reconstruction and rehabilitation, dam construction, large drainage structures, airstrips and aprons, stabilisation and profiling; projects 'overseen at director-level and supported by a team of project managers and expert engineers'. Team page: William Robinson (Director), Caytlyn Mead (CEO), Kym Clark (Finance and Administration Manager), Monika Loeschenbrand (Human Resources).
apply_instructions: No advertised vacancy. RCG's careers page invites applications by email to recruitment@robinsoncivil.com.au.
